verses.text: <pb/><t>Ke mafi kyau cikin matan,</t> <t>Ina ƙaunatacce naki ya tafi?</t> <t>Wace hanya ƙaunatacce naki ya bi?</t> <t>Za mu taimake ki nemansa. <pb/></t>
<t>Ƙaunataccena ya tafi lambunsa inda fangulan furanninsa suke.</t> <t>Yana kiwon garkensa a lambun, yana tattara furannin bi-rana.</t>
<t>Ƙaunataccena nawa ne, ni kuma tasa ce,</t> <t>Yana kiwon garkensa a cikin bi-rana.</t>
<t>Ƙaunatacciyata, kina kyakkyawa kamar Urushalima,</t> <t>Kyakkyawa kuma kamar birnin Tirza,</t> <t>Kina da shiga rai kamar ɗaya daga cikin biranen nan.</t>
<t>Ki daina dubana gama idanunki suna rinjayata,</t> <t>Gashinki yana zarya kamar garken awaki</t> <t>Da yake gangarowa daga tuddan Gileyad.</t>
<t>Haƙoranki farare fat kamar tunkiyar da aka yi mata sausaya</t> <t>Aka yi mata wanka nan da nan.</t> <t>Ba giɓi, suna nan shar.</t> <t>An jera su tantsai.</t>
<t>Ina da matan aure sittin, kowace kuwa sarauniya ce,</t> <t>Da ƙwaraƙwarai tamanin, da 'yan mata kuwa ba a magana!</t>

<t>Amma ɗaya kaɗai nake ƙauna,</t> <t>Ita kyakkyawa ce kamar kurciya.</t> <t>Tilo ce ga mahaifiyarta, 'yar lele ce ga mahaifiyarta.</t> <t>Mata duk sukan dube ta, su yaba.</t> <t>Matan sarki da ƙwaraƙwaransa suka raira waƙa suka yabe ta. <pb/></t>
<t>Wace ce wannan, kamar ketowar alfijir?</t> <t>Ita kyakkyawa ce mai haske, kamar hasken rana,</t> <t>Ko na wata mai kashe ido. <pb/></t>
<t>Na gangara zuwa cikin itatuwan almond</t> <t>Domin in ga ƙananan itatuwan da suke a kwarin,</t> <t>Domin in ga ganyayen inabi</t> <t>Da furannin itatuwan rumman.</t>
<t>Ina karkaɗuwa, don kin sa in ƙosa saboda ƙauna,</t> <t>Kamar mai korar dawakan karusar yaƙi. <pb/></t>
<t>Komo, ki komo, ke Bashulamiya,</t> <t>Ki komo, ki komo domin mu ƙara dubanki. <pb/>Me ya sa kuke so ku dubi Bashulamiya,</t> <t>Sa'ad da take taka rawar zamanin dā?</t>
